justifications.fit: the change adds no new name (run_record_times already existed) and its docstring at review.py:1806 states the invariant rather than the change history, with no version, plan or ticket identifier and no attribution.
justifications.goal_fidelity: reckon/crew/review.py:1800 run_record_times now returns the two-stamp pair and the private helper is gone, with its docstring stating the unknown-commitment rule at review.py:1815, exactly the §9(b) deliverable.
justifications.reuse: the change removes a fork rather than introducing one — the private _run_record_times_found is deleted and its single body is folded into the public run_record_times at review.py:1800, so the run-record lookup has one owner and no capability is duplicated.
